scope: Exact approved native body; canonical2D food image and one globally fixed rest-quad/fullUV mapping only.

globalMapping.coordinateConvention: Continuous image pixel edges; top origin. Semantic support = [midpoint of threshold support left/right edges, bottom edge]. This is a point on the visible plate support, not the old alpha>0 padded quad corner.
globalMapping.exactProjectionRule: Freeze the single source-specific global food mapping before editing. Then every candidate evaluated rest-quad corner must equal the unchanged source evaluated plane matrix applied to that fixed mapped quad, including hidden-state transforms. Full UV/aspect, semantic occupied width and visible support are checked before body occlusion. New corners need not equal old unmapped corners. No per-frame/per-facing placement, scale, depth, crop or color adjustments.
globalMapping.numericTolerance: Use actual native floating-point evaluation, with semantic width/support expected within1e-5world or0.01native pixel; disclose the exact measured residual. Raster alpha/occlusion is reviewed separately at logical and enlarged sizes.
globalMapping.implementationFreedom: Editor may realize the fixed mapping natively by equivalent rest geometry/transform construction that leaves source action/driver behavior intact. Example feasible coordinates and derivation are in reviews/held-food-v2-mapping-evidence.json.
